text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I arrive at the training track<n>to find it much
more crowded than<n>usual.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well... we sure do have a lot of<n>guests today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. I'm used to this kind of<n>clamor from
my races, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That said, it is much easier for me tofocus when it's quiet.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We continue with our training, but I<n>can't help but
notice that Grass<n>Wonder's running seems a bit
lackluster that day.
